description: Take the New mark off regular test categories, as opening one in Test Lab's Categories view does. A category is new when it was made for a capability the system knowledge just found (list_test_categories shows new). Name the categories, or pass all=true for every new one.

all.description: Mark every new category of the project seen.
all.title: All

categories.description: The categories (id or name) to mark seen. Leave out with all=true.
categories.title: Categories

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project
